embedding.license: Derived from synthetic MIT data using Apache-2.0 model; see data/README.md

memory.server_memory_reason: Separate server. This sampler measures the Python client only.
memory.limitations: Sampled RSS may miss peaks shorter than the sampling interval; includes interpreter and imported libraries.

method.recall_semantics: tie-aware-v1; strict ID recall is also reported
method.ground_truth: independent blocked exact search with float64 accumulation on the stored vector values; ID tie-break
method.qps: mean of repeated serial completed requests / wall seconds; includes per-request loop bookkeeping
method.empty_eligible: recall is null and excluded from mean
method.percentile_warning: p99 is unstable for small samples; inspect sample count
method.photo_queries: excluded: frozen text surrogates are not image evaluation
